recap.text: The name Lamashtu first appears on a prize list for a game. Carl reads the Milk of Lamashtu aloud to Mordecai. Mordecai calls the potions a waste.

Chaco rides Lamashtu the Donkey, a level 125 subjugated god with crow's talons and a red closed eye symbol. The AI owns her as a mount to message other gods. Her level is halved because she has no worshippers. After Grigori and Chaco leave her in the road, she speaks with a slug driving a chicken truck and walks toward the crawlers' garage.

beats.headline: A scroll with her name on it
beats.text: For the record: this name first appears on a prize list. Among the scroll choices for the three- and five-hand prizes at this evening's game is one called the Milk of Lamashtu. Crawler Carl reads it out to Mordecai alongside a scroll of mapping and one called Paw Patrol, and admits he does not know what any of these do. Mordecai calls the potions a waste and recommends the boost to Crawler Donut's lowest base stat and a random spell book instead. The name is logged.
beats.gist: Carl reads the name Milk of Lamashtu from a prize list to Mordecai.

beats.headline: A donkey with a closed eye
beats.text: Chaco rides into the parade on a donkey bigger than Sweety, dressed in yellow-and-blue regalia, rhinestoned tack and a showgirl headdress. She has crow's talons where hooves should be, and over her head a small symbol: the red curve of a closed eye. Lamashtu the Donkey, level 125, a mortal, subjugated god. The subjugator field reads Error, and then the AI owns up: it did this, and the donkey is its property now. It wanted a mount for its grand master, and a message for any watching gods that they are next.
beats.gist: Chaco rides a donkey in a showgirl headdress; the AI owns the subjugated god Lamashtu.

beats.headline: Halved, and tied to her captor
beats.text: The terms of her condition, as the notice sets them out. She has no worshippers left, so under the Ascendency rules her level has been cut in half and she has lost most of her powers. As a subjugated deity she stays alive only as long as her subjugator does. If that subjugator is itself subjugated rather than killed, her power halves again and she passes to the new master. From the procession, Samantha recognises her as a friend: Lammy is grumpy about being ridden, she says, so she must like Chaco.
beats.gist: Lamashtu is a subjugated god and a mount.

beats.headline: The fleshmancer on her back
beats.text: Chaco loses his wings on her back and collapses. The AI takes over Grigori, who lands on the donkey and takes the microphone, and the pair pull off the road to wait by the stands while every float passes. When the court's float goes by, the fleshmancer is standing upon her with Chaco at his feet, still in the red, and Crawler Carl heals Chaco while holding the AI's gaze.
beats.gist: Lamashtu is a subjugated god and the AI's mount.

beats.headline: Left standing in the road
beats.text: Afterwards, the broadcast shows the AI releasing Grigori, and Chaco, just as bewildered, blinking away and leaving the donkey behind. The chicken truck, driven by the slug who finished off Vinata, putters to a stop beside her. They exchange words. Lamashtu turns and walks alongside the other animals streaming toward the crawlers' garage. That is the last position logged for her on this floor.
beats.gist: The AI releases Grigori and Chaco, leaving Lamashtu the Donkey in the road.
